scores.tell: Duck is fattened toy-like blob, pillowy body and wings; spring and base are chunky with soft rounded corners.
Bottle body is soft and swollen, thick strap loop and rounded base, but overall form is plausible and simplified.
Calculator has tight planar faces and crisp keys; only slightly puffy edge bevel.
Barrel is the same swollen, rounded form as the grade 3 lesson; bands are heavy and the lid is a soft pillow.
Ship is well proportioned with thin masts and rigging; hull is a little round and sails are billowy.
Flip-flops have a clean flat sole and a thin strap; the sole is slightly pillowy and the bumps are uniform.
Wagon proportions are off: the canvas is a large smooth tube, the wheels are oversized and puffy, and the front is cut off.
Clock is a clean disc with a thick, rounded orange rim and thin hands; rim is a little swollen.
Locker has flat panels and crisp louvres; the corners and base feet are a bit soft, but the form is accurate.
Rocket is a clean silhouette with thin fins and rim rivets; the body is slightly swollen but proportions are plausible.
